summary: No electric-scooter money for 2027 is confirmed. The central purchase subsidy (MOEA) ends 2026-12-31 and no successor was found. The one 2027 signal is a draft: on 2026-11-11 the environment ministry pre-announced extending its scrap-and-replace air subsidy to the end of 2030. It is not final, and the roughly NT$1,000 scooter amount comes from secondary coverage. New Taipei says it is drafting a 2027 plan and Taoyuan is studying one, with no amounts. Buy and register before 2026-12-31. The ministry's platform treats the carbon and air payments as separate claims, and its February release says qualifying people can apply for both. Confirm before relying on the total. Gasoline goods-tax cuts for scooters run to 2030-12-31. Electric licence tax and goods tax are exempt to 2030-12-31 and the road fee will not start before 2030. Petrol is held down about NT$6 a litre (92 at NT$31.2); the fuel goods-tax cut runs only to 2027-03-31.

A search result citing 食尚玩家/自由時報 says the draft table gives scooters 1,000 (22.07 kg VOC) and adds hybrids at 50%; I did not open those, so the 1,000 scooter figure is SECONDARY. findings.subject: Road fee for electric vehicles
findings.valueText: Exemption extended to 2030-12-31 (交通部, via U-CAR 2026-06-09). Earlier 交通部 statement (聯合報 2025-12-02): charging from 2030 at the earliest, based on 797,000 electric scooters at end of Oct 2025 and 2.4 million expected by 2030. Scooter rate not set; set by 交通部 with 財政部. 運研所 review expected end-2026.
findings.verifierNote: The two articles are different laws and dates: 聯合報 2025-12-02 (公路法 amendment passed the day before) and U-CAR 2026-06-09 (市區道路條例 amendment). 'End of Oct' is 2025 (confirmed). The 2030-start versus exemption-to-2030-12-31 are not clearly reconciled; practically no charge before 2030-12-31. Media reports of 交通部 statements, no 交通部 page opened.
